summary.en: A few thousand Han loyalists under Liu Xiu broke a vastly larger Xin army besieging Kunyang. The rout doomed Wang Mang, whose capital Chang'an fell to rebels later that year.
summary.zh: 刘秀率数千汉军冲破围攻昆阳的新莽大军，王莽主力溃散，同年长安被起义军攻破，王莽被杀。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
范晔《后汉书》卷1上 光武帝纪上 地皇四年
资治通鉴 卷39 汉纪三十一 淮阳王更始元年

story.en:
In 23 CE Wang Mang sent his generals Wang Yi and Wang Xun with an army the Hou Han shu puts at 420,000 men (boasted as a million) to crush the Han restoration movement. They surrounded Kunyang, a small walled town held by fewer than ten thousand rebels. Liu Xiu, a minor scion of the Han house, slipped out at night with thirteen riders to gather help from nearby garrisons.

He came back with a few thousand men and led the charge himself. The Xin commanders, contemptuous of so small a force, ordered their units to stay in camp; Wang Xun was cut down, the defenders sallied from the town, and a violent storm swelled the Zhi River behind the routed army. Tens of thousands drowned, the Hou Han shu says, as the host disintegrated.

The defeat broke Wang Mang's last field army. Within months rebels entered Chang'an and killed him in his palace. Liu Xiu, who had to hide his grief when the Gengshi Emperor executed his elder brother Liu Yan soon after, went on to build his own power in the north and refounded the Han in 25.
story.zh:
公元23年，王莽派王邑、王寻率大军镇压汉兵，《后汉书》称其兵四十二万，号称百万。大军包围了守军不足万人的小城昆阳。汉室远支刘秀夜率十三骑突围，往邻近诸县征集援兵。

刘秀带回数千人马，亲自冲锋陷阵。新莽主将轻视这支小部队，下令各营按兵不动，结果王寻阵亡，城中守军乘势杀出，又逢狂风暴雨，滍水暴涨，溃兵争相渡河，溺死者以万计，大军就此瓦解。

昆阳一役摧毁了王莽最后的主力。数月后起义军攻入长安，王莽死于宫中。不久更始帝杀刘秀长兄刘縯，刘秀强忍悲痛不露声色，后来出巡河北另建基业，于公元25年重建汉朝，是为东汉。

name.en: Founding of the White Horse Temple

summary.en: Traditionally regarded as China's first Buddhist temple, founded outside Luoyang under Emperor Ming after envoys returned from the west with the monks Kasyapa Matanga and Dharmaratna.
summary.zh: 相传汉明帝遣使西行求法，迎摄摩腾、竺法兰至洛阳，于城西建白马寺，被视为中国第一座佛寺。

Britannica: White Horse Temple

name.en: Battle of Ikh Bayan and the Yanran inscription
name.zh: 稽落山之战与燕然勒石

summary.en: General Dou Xian crushed the Northern Xiongnu at Mount Jiluo and had Ban Gu compose a victory inscription carved on Mount Yanran in the Khangai range, rediscovered in Mongolia in 2017.
summary.zh: 窦宪大破北匈奴于稽落山，登燕然山命班固作铭刻石记功；该摩崖石刻于2017年在蒙古国杭爱山发现。

summary.en: At Luoyang the astronomer Zhang Heng built the Houfeng Didong Yi, a bronze vessel said to drop a ball from a dragon's mouth toward the direction of a distant earthquake.
summary.zh: 太史令张衡在洛阳制成候风地动仪，据载地震时对应方向的龙口吐丸，可感知远方地震。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
范晔《后汉书》卷59 张衡传

summary.en: Zhang Jue's Taiping Dao movement rose across eastern China in 184. The main armies were crushed within a year, but the emergency powers granted to regional commanders opened the way to warlordism.
summary.zh: 张角以太平道起事于巨鹿，八州并起。主力当年即被镇压，但余部延续二十年，地方将帅坐大，开启军阀割据。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
范晔《后汉书》卷71 皇甫嵩传
资治通鉴 卷58 汉纪五十 光和七年

note: Wikidata ends the rebellion in 205 (remnant risings); the main outbreak was 184, as in Jiangshan-map.

story.en:
Zhang Jue, a healer from Julu, spent a decade building the Way of Great Peace (Taiping Dao), curing the sick with talismans and confession and organising followers into thirty-six fang, or divisions. His slogan announced that "the Azure Heaven is dead; the Yellow Heaven shall rise" in the jiazi year, 184.

The plan was betrayed: his agent Ma Yuanyi was torn apart by chariots in Luoyang, and the movement rose early, in the second month of 184, its fighters wearing yellow headcloths. Across eight provinces officials were killed and towns burned. The court lifted its ban on the proscribed literati, freed funds, and sent Huangfu Song, Zhu Jun and Lu Zhi against the rebels. Zhang Jue died of illness that year; his brothers Zhang Liang and Zhang Bao were killed, and his corpse was dug up and beheaded.

Remnant bands fought on for twenty years, from the Black Mountain bandits to the Qingzhou Yellow Turbans whom Cao Cao absorbed in 192. In 188 the court made provincial governors into military "shepherds" (zhoumu), and those regional armies became the warlord forces that tore the Han apart.
story.zh:
巨鹿人张角以符水咒说为人治病，传布太平道十余年，将信众编为三十六方。他提出“苍天已死，黄天当立，岁在甲子，天下大吉”，约定于甲子年（184年）起事。

因叛徒告密，弟子马元义在洛阳被车裂，张角只得于184年二月提前举事，徒众头裹黄巾，八州同时响应，杀官吏、焚城邑。朝廷解除党锢、拿出内库钱财，派皇甫嵩、朱儁、卢植分路征讨。张角当年病死，其弟张梁、张宝先后战死，张角遭剖棺戮尸。

余部此后延续二十年，从黑山军到192年被曹操收编的青州黄巾都是其流裔。188年朝廷又改刺史为州牧，赋予军政大权，这些地方武装后来演变为瓜分东汉的割据势力。

summary.en: Dong Zhuo's seizure of Luoyang in 189 reduced the Han emperors to puppets; Cao Cao later controlled Emperor Xian from Xu, and in 220 his son Cao Pi accepted the abdication and founded Wei.
summary.zh: 189年董卓入洛废立，汉帝沦为傀儡；曹操迎献帝都许挟天子以令诸侯，220年曹丕受禅建魏，东汉亡。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)

《三国志》 卷2 魏书二 文帝纪 黄初二年 裴注引《魏略》改长安、谯、许昌、邺、洛阳为五都
《资治通鉴》 卷69 魏纪一 黄初元年七月 王次于谯大飨
陈寿《三国志》卷2 魏书二 文帝纪

story.en:
When Emperor Ling died in 189, the regent He Jin plotted to destroy the palace eunuchs and summoned the frontier general Dong Zhuo to the capital. The eunuchs murdered He Jin first; Yuan Shao then stormed the palace and slaughtered them. Dong Zhuo arrived amid the chaos, deposed the young emperor and installed his half-brother Liu Xie as Emperor Xian.

A coalition of eastern governors rose against Dong in 190, and he burned Luoyang and dragged the court to Chang'an, where Lü Bu killed him in 192. The emperor escaped east in ruins; in 196 Cao Cao received him at Xu and thereafter, as the saying goes, "held the Son of Heaven to command the lords." For twenty-four years every edict carried the emperor's seal and Cao Cao's will.

Cao Cao died in early 220. Later that year his son Cao Pi staged a formal abdication on a terrace at Fanyang (in modern Linying, Henan): after ritual refusals he accepted the throne and founded Wei. Liu Xie became Duke of Shanyang and lived quietly until 234, while Liu Bei and Sun Quan soon claimed their own thrones.
story.zh:
189年汉灵帝去世，大将军何进谋诛宦官，召并州牧董卓进京。宦官抢先杀死何进，袁绍随即攻入宫中尽诛宦官。董卓乘乱入洛阳，废少帝，立其弟刘协为汉献帝。

190年关东州郡起兵讨董，董卓焚毁洛阳，挟天子西迁长安，192年被吕布所杀。献帝历尽艰辛东归，196年曹操迎驾都许，从此“挟天子以令诸侯”，二十四年间诏书虽用汉帝之印，实出曹操之意。

220年初曹操去世。同年冬，曹丕在繁阳（今河南临颍）筑坛受禅，经过三让之礼接受帝位，建立魏朝。刘协被封为山阳公，安然度过余生，至234年去世；刘备、孙权随后也相继称帝。

summary.en: Cao Cao defeated the far larger army of Yuan Shao by burning its grain depot at Wuchao, gaining control of north China.
summary.zh: 曹操奇袭乌巢焚毁袁绍粮草，以少胜多大败袁军，奠定统一北方的基础。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
陈寿《三国志》卷1 魏书一 武帝纪 建安五年
资治通鉴 卷63 汉纪五十五 建安五年

story.en:
By 200 Yuan Shao held four northern provinces and marched south from Ye with more than a hundred thousand men. Cao Cao, who controlled the emperor but a smaller and poorer territory, dug in at Guandu on the road to his base at Xu. For months the two armies traded arrows from earthen mounds and tunnels while Cao's grain ran desperately low.

The turning point came when Xu You, an adviser whose counsel Yuan Shao ignored, defected and told Cao that the enemy's supply depot lay at Wuchao under Chunyu Qiong. Cao led five thousand picked men there himself by night, carrying Yuan banners, and burned the stores. When news of the fire reached Yuan's camp, his generals Zhang He and Gao Lan went over to Cao, and the great army collapsed; Yuan Shao fled north with a few hundred horsemen.

Afterwards Cao's men found letters that some of his own officers had written to Yuan. According to the Sanguozhi, he burned them unread, saying that even he had doubted he could survive. Yuan Shao died in 202, his sons fought one another, and by 207 Cao Cao ruled all of north China.
story.zh:
200年，袁绍据有冀、青、幽、并四州，自邺城率十余万大军南下。曹操虽奉天子，但地狭兵少，扼守在通往许都要道上的官渡。双方相持数月，筑土山、挖地道，互相射箭，曹军粮草几近断绝。

转机来自袁绍谋士许攸。他屡献计不被采纳，转而投奔曹操，告知袁军粮草囤积在淳于琼驻守的乌巢。曹操亲率五千精兵，打着袁军旗号连夜奔袭，焚毁全部粮草。消息传回袁营，大将张郃、高览投降曹操，袁军全线崩溃，袁绍仅带八百余骑渡河北逃。

战后曹军缴获了自己部下私通袁绍的书信。据《三国志》裴注所载，曹操下令全部焚毁、不予追究，说当时连自己都难以自保。202年袁绍病死，诸子相争，至207年曹操统一北方。

summary.en: The allied fleets of Sun Quan and Liu Bei, led by Zhou Yu, burned Cao Cao's armada on the Yangtze near Wulin, halting his drive south and setting the stage for the Three Kingdoms.
summary.zh: 孙权、刘备联军由周瑜指挥，黄盖火攻，于乌林焚毁曹操战船，阻止其南下，奠定三国鼎立格局。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
陈寿《三国志》卷54 吴书九 周瑜传
资治通鉴 卷65 汉纪五十七 建安十三年

story.en:
In 208 Cao Cao swept into Jingzhou; Liu Biao's heir surrendered and Liu Bei fled south with refugees after a rout at Changban. Liu Bei sent Zhuge Liang to Sun Quan, and Sun's commander Zhou Yu argued that Cao's northern troops were sick, unused to boats and far from home. Sun Quan agreed to fight, and some thirty thousand men under Zhou Yu and Cheng Pu sailed upriver.

The fleets met at the Red Cliffs, and Cao withdrew to the north bank at Wulin. According to the Sanguozhi, the veteran Huang Gai noticed that Cao's warships were moored close together, bow to stern, and proposed fire. He sent a letter feigning surrender, then approached with boats packed with dry reeds and oil. Fanned by a strong wind, the flames spread from the ships to the camps on shore, and Cao's army, already weakened by disease, retreated overland through the marshes of Huarong.

The Romance of the Three Kingdoms adds Zhuge Liang conjuring the east wind and "borrowing arrows" with straw boats; those are fiction. The real result was enough: Cao never again crossed the Yangtze, and the three-way division of China took shape.
story.zh:
208年曹操南下荆州，刘表之子刘琮投降，刘备在长坂坡大败后携百姓南逃。刘备派诸葛亮出使孙权，孙权部将周瑜也力陈曹军北方士卒多病、不习水战、远道疲惫。孙权决意抗曹，派周瑜、程普率三万水军溯江西上。

两军相遇于赤壁，曹军退泊江北乌林。据《三国志》记载，老将黄盖见曹军战船“首尾相接”，建议火攻。他先致书诈降，再以满载干荻、浇灌膏油的船只驶近曹营，借着强风点火，火势从船上一直烧到岸上营寨。本已疫病流行的曹军大败，经华容道沼泽撤回北方。

《三国演义》中诸葛亮借东风、草船借箭等情节均属小说虚构。但真实的结果已足够深远：曹操此后再未越过长江，三国鼎立的格局由此奠定。

summary.en: Liu Bei invaded Wu to avenge Guan Yu and recover Jingzhou; the Wu commander Lu Xun waited, then burned the Shu camps strung along the gorges at Yiling, and Liu Bei withdrew to Baidicheng.
summary.zh: 刘备为报关羽之仇、夺回荆州而伐吴，陆逊坚守待机，于夷陵火烧连营，刘备败退白帝城。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
陈寿《三国志》卷58 吴书十三 陆逊传
资治通鉴 卷69 魏纪一 黄初三年

note: The campaign began in 221 (Wikidata date) and the decisive fire attack came in 222 (Jiangshan-map date).

story.en:
In 219 Sun Quan's general Lü Meng seized Jingzhou behind Guan Yu's back, and Guan Yu was captured and beheaded. Liu Bei, who had proclaimed himself emperor of Han in Chengdu in 221, resolved on revenge against the advice of Zhao Yun and others. Even before he set out, his sworn brother Zhang Fei was murdered by his own officers.

Liu Bei led his army down the Three Gorges and early in 222 strung dozens of fortified camps along hundreds of li of riverbank from Wu Gorge to Yiling. Sun Quan's young commander Lu Xun refused to give battle for months, ignoring the grumbling of veteran Wu officers, and waited for the Shu troops to tire in the summer heat. Then he struck with fire, burning the camps one after another and breaking more than forty of them. Liu Bei barely escaped to Baidicheng.

The Sanguozhi says Liu Bei, shamed, blamed fate for his defeat by a man he had dismissed. He died at Baidicheng in 223 after entrusting his son Liu Shan to Zhuge Liang, who quickly restored the alliance with Wu that held until Shu fell.
story.zh:
219年孙权部将吕蒙袭取荆州，关羽兵败被杀。221年在成都称帝的刘备不听赵云等人劝阻，执意东征复仇；大军尚未出发，张飞已被部下刺杀。

刘备沿三峡东下，222年在巫峡至夷陵数百里江岸上连营数十屯。东吴年轻的主将陆逊坚守不战数月，不顾老将们的不满，等待蜀军在盛夏中疲惫松懈，随后以火攻突袭，接连焚破蜀军四十余营。刘备仅以身免，退回白帝城。

据《三国志》记载，刘备深感羞愤，自叹败于陆逊之手乃是天意。223年他病逝白帝城，临终托孤于诸葛亮。诸葛亮随即重修吴蜀之好，这一联盟一直维持到蜀汉灭亡。

summary.en: From Hanzhong, Shu chancellor Zhuge Liang launched five campaigns against Wei through the Qinling passes. Supply problems and Sima Yi's defensive strategy stalled them, and he died in camp at Wuzhang Plains in 234.
summary.zh: 蜀相诸葛亮以汉中为基地，越秦岭五次北伐曹魏。粮运艰难，司马懿坚壁不战，234年病逝五丈原军中。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
《三国志》 卷3 魏书三 明帝纪 太和二年春 丁未，行幸长安
《资治通鉴》 卷71 魏纪三 太和二年 丁未，帝行如长安
陈寿《三国志》卷35 蜀书五 诸葛亮传
资治通鉴 卷71–72 魏纪三、四

story.en:
After pacifying the south, Zhuge Liang moved to Hanzhong in 227 and submitted his memorial on going to war (Chu shi biao), urging the young emperor Liu Shan to trust honest ministers while he marched to "restore the Han." In spring 228 he advanced on Mount Qi, and three Wei commanderies went over to him at once.

The chance was lost at Jieting. His protégé Ma Su ignored orders, abandoned the water supply and camped on a hilltop; the Wei general Zhang He surrounded him and scattered his army. Zhuge Liang withdrew, executed Ma Su in tears, and asked to be demoted three grades. Later campaigns took Wudu and Yinping, killed Zhang He at Mumen in 231, and experimented with "wooden oxen" for hauling grain, but supply over the Qinling never sufficed.

In 234 he camped at Wuzhang Plains to farm while facing Sima Yi, who refused battle even when, as Jin-era accounts say, Zhuge sent him women's clothing as a taunt. Zhuge Liang died there in autumn 234. The Romance's "six sorties from Mount Qi" exaggerates; historians count five campaigns, two of them via Mount Qi.
story.zh:
平定南中后，诸葛亮于227年进驻汉中，上《出师表》，劝勉后主刘禅亲贤臣、远小人，自己则誓师北伐“兴复汉室”。228年春，他兵出祁山，天水、南安、安定三郡一时响应。

良机失于街亭。爱将马谡违背节度，舍水上山，被魏将张郃围困断水，大败而逃。诸葛亮被迫撤军，挥泪斩马谡，并上疏自贬三等。此后他又攻取武都、阴平，231年在木门道射杀张郃，并创制木牛流马运粮，但翻越秦岭的补给始终难以为继。

234年，诸葛亮屯田五丈原，与司马懿对峙。据晋代史料记载，他甚至送去妇人衣饰相激，司马懿仍坚壁不出。同年秋，诸葛亮病逝军中。《三国演义》所谓“六出祁山”有所夸张，史家一般认为北伐共五次，其中只有两次出祁山。

summary.en: While regent Cao Shuang escorted the Wei emperor to the Gaoping tombs, Sima Yi seized Luoyang and then executed Cao Shuang's faction, putting the Sima clan in control of Wei.
summary.zh: 曹爽奉魏帝谒高平陵之际，司马懿闭城发动政变，诛曹爽一党，司马氏自此掌握曹魏朝政。

summary.en: Wei armies under Zhong Hui and Deng Ai invaded Shu; while Jiang Wei held Jiange, Deng Ai crossed the mountains by the Yinping trail and reached Chengdu, where Liu Shan surrendered.
summary.zh: 钟会、邓艾分道伐蜀，姜维据守剑阁，邓艾偷渡阴平直抵成都，后主刘禅出降，蜀汉亡。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
《三国志》 卷33 蜀书三 后主传 炎兴元年冬 邓艾破诸葛瞻于绵竹，用谯周策降于艾
《三国志》 卷28 魏书二十八 邓艾传 艾至成都，禅率太子诸王及群臣面缚舆榇诣军门
《资治通鉴》 卷78 魏纪十 景元四年 艾至成都城北，汉主面缚舆榇
陈寿《三国志》卷28 魏书二十八 邓艾传

story.en:
In 263 the Wei regent Sima Zhao, seeking glory before claiming the throne, sent three armies against Shu. Zhong Hui led the main force of more than a hundred thousand through the Qinling valleys into Hanzhong, but the Shu commander Jiang Wei fell back to Jiange, a narrow pass in the cliffs, and stopped him cold.

Deng Ai then gambled. With a picked force he left the road at Yinping and struck across some seven hundred li of uninhabited mountains, cutting tracks and bridging gorges. The Sanguozhi says that on one steep slope he wrapped himself in a felt blanket and rolled down. Emerging at Jiangyou, he defeated Zhuge Liang's son Zhuge Zhan at Mianzhu, and the road to Chengdu lay open. Liu Shan surrendered without a siege.

The victors soon destroyed one another. Zhong Hui had Deng Ai arrested and plotted with Jiang Wei to rebel, but in early 264 the army mutinied and killed them all. Liu Shan was taken to Luoyang, where, asked whether he missed Shu, he reportedly said he was too happy to think of it. In 265 Sima Yan replaced Wei with Jin.
story.zh:
263年，魏国权臣司马昭为在篡位前立威，分兵三路伐蜀。钟会统领十余万主力穿越秦岭诸谷进入汉中，蜀将姜维退守剑阁，凭险据守，魏军不得前进。

邓艾于是出奇兵，率精兵自阴平小道翻越七百余里无人山地，凿山开路、架桥过谷。《三国志》记载，遇到陡坡时邓艾以毡自裹，推转而下。魏军出江油后在绵竹击败诸葛亮之子诸葛瞻，成都门户洞开，后主刘禅不战而降。

胜利者随即自相残杀。钟会诬陷邓艾、将其收押，并与姜维密谋自立，264年初魏军哗变，钟会、姜维、邓艾先后被杀。刘禅被迁往洛阳，有人问他是否思念蜀地，他答道“此间乐，不思蜀”。265年，司马炎代魏建晋。

summary.en: Six Jin columns attacked Wu, and Wang Jun's fleet sailed down the Yangtze from Sichuan to Jianye, where Sun Hao surrendered in 280, reunifying China for the first time since the Han.
summary.zh: 西晋六路伐吴，王濬楼船自益州顺江而下直抵建业，280年孙皓出降，结束三国分裂。

story.en:
Jin planned the conquest of Wu for years. The general Yang Hu argued for it until his death in 278 and recommended Du Yu to carry it out, while in Sichuan Wang Jun spent seven years building great tower ships. The Jin shu says wood chips from the shipyards floated down the Yangtze, and a Wu governor sent some to his court as a warning that went unheeded.

In late 279 Emperor Wu of Jin sent six columns across a front of thousands of li. Wu had blocked the Yangtze gorges with iron chains and hidden iron spikes; Wang Jun sent great rafts ahead to catch the spikes and burned through the chains with torches soaked in oil. His fleet swept downriver, took Wuchang and reached Jianye in the spring of 280 before rival Jin generals could claim the prize.

The Wu emperor Sun Hao, notorious for his cruelty, surrendered with his hands bound and a coffin carried behind him, the traditional gesture of submission. China was united for the first time in sixty years. Centuries later the Tang poet Liu Yuxi wrote of Wang Jun's ships descending from Yizhou as the royal aura of Jinling faded.
story.zh:
西晋筹划灭吴多年。羊祜生前力主伐吴，278年临终推荐杜预继任；益州刺史王濬在蜀地营造大型楼船长达七年。《晋书》记载，造船削下的木屑顺江漂下，吴国建平太守吾彦取以上报，请求加强防备，却未被理会。

279年冬，晋武帝发兵六路，战线绵延数千里。吴军在长江险要处设铁锁横江，又在水中暗置铁锥。王濬先放出巨大木筏挂走铁锥，再用灌满麻油的火炬烧熔铁锁，楼船顺流直下，攻克武昌，于280年春抢在其他晋将之前抵达建业。

以残暴著称的吴主孙皓面缚舆榇，出城投降，三国分裂自此结束，天下重归一统。数百年后，唐代诗人刘禹锡写下“王濬楼船下益州，金陵王气黯然收”的名句。

summary.en: A succession of Jin princes, beginning with Empress Jia's coup, fought for control of the weak Emperor Hui. The civil wars devastated the north and drew Xiongnu and other frontier troops into Chinese politics.
summary.zh: 贾后乱政后，宗室诸王为控制晋惠帝相继混战十六年，中原残破，匈奴等内迁部族借机起兵。

story.en:
Emperor Wu of Jin had placed his sons and kinsmen in command of armies to protect the dynasty, but his heir, Emperor Hui, was incapable of governing. The Jin shu tells that, hearing people were starving for lack of grain, he asked why they did not eat minced meat instead. Real power went to whoever controlled him.

In 291 Empress Jia Nanfeng destroyed the regent Yang Jun, then used the Prince of Chu to kill the Prince of Runan before executing Chu himself. When she murdered the crown prince in 300, the Prince of Zhao, Sima Lun, killed her and in 301 seized the throne. Over the next five years the Princes of Qi, Changsha, Chengdu, Hejian and Donghai fought for Luoyang in turn, each victory followed by mass executions; the emperor was dragged between Luoyang, Ye and Chang'an.

By 306 the Prince of Donghai, Sima Yue, was the last one standing, but the realm was ruined. The princes had recruited Xiongnu, Xianbei and other frontier troops; in 304 the Xiongnu noble Liu Yuan, sent home to raise cavalry for the Prince of Chengdu, instead proclaimed his own Han state, beginning the era of the Sixteen Kingdoms.
story.zh:
晋武帝分封宗室诸王并授以兵权，意在屏卫皇室，但继位的晋惠帝智力低下，不能理政。《晋书》记载，他听说百姓因饥荒没有饭吃，竟问“何不食肉糜”。谁能控制皇帝，谁便掌握朝政。

291年，贾后贾南风诛杀辅政的杨骏，又借楚王司马玮之手杀汝南王司马亮，随即反诛楚王。300年贾后害死太子，赵王司马伦起兵杀贾后，301年篡位称帝。此后五年间，齐王、长沙王、成都王、河间王、东海王相继争夺洛阳，每次得胜都伴随大规模屠戮，惠帝被裹挟往返于洛阳、邺城和长安之间。

到306年，东海王司马越成为最后的胜者，但天下已残破不堪。诸王争相借用匈奴、鲜卑等部族兵力；304年，奉成都王之命回乡召集骑兵的匈奴贵族刘渊在左国城自立，建立汉国，十六国时代由此开端。

summary.en: Han-Zhao forces under Liu Yao and Wang Mi stormed Luoyang, captured Emperor Huai and burned the city, triggering a mass migration of northern elites south of the Yangtze.
summary.zh: 汉赵刘曜、王弥攻陷洛阳，俘晋怀帝，焚掠宫城，引发中原士族大规模南迁（衣冠南渡）。

story.en:
By 311 the Western Jin court in Luoyang was starving and isolated. The regent Sima Yue had led the capital's best troops away and died in camp; when his army escorted his coffin east, Shi Le's cavalry caught it at Ningping and massacred more than a hundred thousand men, including much of the court aristocracy.

In the summer of 311 Han-Zhao forces under Liu Yao, Wang Mi and Huyan Yan broke into Luoyang. They killed tens of thousands, looted and burned the palaces, dug up imperial tombs and carried Emperor Huai off to the Han capital at Pingyang. There, the histories say, he was made to serve wine to his captors at a banquet dressed in a servant's blue robe before being killed in 313. His successor in Chang'an was captured in 316, ending the Western Jin.

The disaster sent a great wave of northern families, scholars and commoners south across the Huai and Yangtze, the movement remembered as the "southward crossing of the robed and capped." At Jiankang in 317 the Prince of Langya, Sima Rui, re-founded the dynasty as the Eastern Jin with the Wang clan's support, and north and south went separate ways for nearly three centuries.
story.zh:
到311年，西晋洛阳朝廷粮尽援绝。执政的东海王司马越带走京师精锐，病死军中；其部众护送灵柩东归，在宁平城被石勒骑兵追及，十余万人遭屠杀，朝中公卿多数罹难。

311年夏，汉赵刘曜、王弥、呼延晏攻入洛阳，杀死官民三万余人，焚掠宫室，发掘陵墓，并将晋怀帝俘往平阳。据史书记载，313年汉主宴会群臣时命怀帝穿青衣为众人斟酒，不久将其杀害。在长安即位的晋愍帝于316年被俘，西晋灭亡。

这场浩劫促使大批北方士族、学者与百姓渡过淮河、长江南迁，史称“衣冠南渡”。317年琅琊王司马睿在王导等琅琊王氏支持下于建康重建晋室，是为东晋，此后南北分立近三百年。

summary.en: Wang Xizhi hosted some forty literati at the Orchid Pavilion near Shanyin (Shaoxing) for the spring purification festival and wrote the preface to their poems, later revered as the supreme work of Chinese calligraphy.
summary.zh: 王羲之与谢安等四十余人修禊于会稽山阴兰亭，作《兰亭集序》，被后世尊为“天下第一行书”。

summary.en: Fu Jian's huge Former Qin army, attempting to conquer the south, was routed at the Fei River near Shouyang by about 80,000 Eastern Jin troops under Xie Xuan; the defeat broke up Former Qin.
summary.zh: 前秦苻坚倾国南下，于寿阳淝水被谢玄所率八万北府兵击溃，前秦随之瓦解，南北对峙之局延续。

story.en:
Fu Jian of Former Qin had united the north by 376 and resolved to finish the job. His great minister Wang Meng had warned on his deathbed not to attack the Jin, but in 383 Fu Jian marched south with an army the Jin shu numbers at well over 800,000, boasting that if his men threw their whips into the Yangtze they could dam its flow.

The Eastern Jin chancellor Xie An entrusted the defence to his brother Xie Shi and nephew Xie Xuan, whose Northern Garrison troops numbered about eighty thousand. After a sharp Jin victory at Luojian, the armies faced each other across the Fei River near Shouyang. Xie Xuan asked Fu Jian to draw back so the Jin could cross and fight. Fu Jian agreed, intending to strike them mid-river, but the withdrawal turned into panic when the captured Jin officer Zhu Xu shouted that Qin was beaten. Fu Rong was killed and the vast army fled; according to the Jin shu, the fugitives took the sound of the wind and the cry of cranes for pursuing troops.

Xie An, told the news while playing weiqi, reportedly went on with the game. Former Qin broke apart into Later Yan, Later Qin and other states, and the south survived.
story.zh:
前秦苻坚于376年统一北方，决意南下灭晋。名相王猛临终前曾劝他不要攻打东晋，但383年苻坚仍倾国南征，《晋书》载其兵力八十余万，他夸口说“投鞭于江，足断其流”。

东晋宰相谢安命弟谢石、侄谢玄领兵抵御，北府兵约八万人。晋军先在洛涧告捷，随后与秦军隔淝水对峙于寿阳附近。谢玄请秦军稍稍后撤，以便晋军渡河决战。苻坚想趁晋军半渡时出击，便同意后撤，不料阵脚一动便无法收拾，被俘的晋将朱序在阵后大呼“秦军败矣”，秦军顿时大溃，苻融阵亡。据《晋书》记载，逃兵“闻风声鹤唳，皆以为王师已至”。

捷报传来时谢安正与客人下棋，据说他看完书信不动声色，照常对弈。前秦随后分崩离析，后燕、后秦等政权相继建立，东晋得以保全。

name.en: Emperor Xiaowen moves the capital to Luoyang

summary.en: Emperor Xiaowen of Northern Wei moved his court from Pingcheng to Luoyang and imposed Chinese dress, language and surnames on the Xianbei aristocracy as part of his sinicisation reforms.
summary.zh: 北魏孝文帝自平城迁都洛阳，推行改汉服、说汉语、改汉姓等汉化改革。

story.en:
Emperor Xiaowen of Northern Wei had been raised by his grandmother, Empress Dowager Feng, whose reforms of the 480s, among them the equal-field system, already pushed the Xianbei state toward Chinese models. After her death in 490 he went further, but he knew the conservative nobles of Pingcheng (modern Datong) would resist leaving their northern homeland.

So in 493 he announced a grand campaign against the Southern Qi and marched south with his army. When they reached Luoyang in heavy autumn rains, the exhausted nobles begged him to call it off. He agreed, on condition that the capital be moved to Luoyang instead, and most accepted rather than march on. The move was proclaimed in 494.

Over the next few years he banned Xianbei dress, ordered officials under thirty to speak Chinese at court, changed the imperial surname Tuoba to Yuan, encouraged marriage with leading Han families and began the Longmen grottoes. His own crown prince, who hated the heat of Luoyang and the new ways, tried to flee north and was forced to kill himself. The reforms forged a new northern elite, but the neglected frontier garrisons later revolted in 524.
story.zh:
北魏孝文帝自幼由祖母冯太后抚养，冯太后在480年代推行均田制等改革，已使鲜卑政权向汉制靠拢。490年冯太后去世后，孝文帝决心更进一步，但他深知平城（今大同）的守旧贵族不愿离开北方故土。

于是493年，他宣布大举南伐南齐，亲率大军南下。抵达洛阳时秋雨连绵，疲惫的群臣跪请停止南征。孝文帝顺势提出：不南伐就须迁都洛阳。多数人宁愿迁都也不愿继续行军，494年正式迁都。

此后数年，他禁穿胡服，规定三十岁以下的官员在朝廷上须说汉语，改皇族拓跋氏为元氏，提倡与汉族高门通婚，并开凿龙门石窟。太子元恂不耐洛阳炎热、厌恶新政，企图逃回北方，被废后赐死。改革塑造了新的北方门阀，但遭冷落的北边军镇后来于524年爆发六镇之乱。

summary.en: Neglected northern frontier garrisons of Northern Wei rose under Poliuhan Baling at Woye. The revolts brought warlords such as Erzhu Rong, Gao Huan and Yuwen Tai to power and split the empire.
summary.zh: 北魏北边六镇军民因地位沦落而起事，破六韩拔陵首倡于沃野镇。尔朱荣、高欢、宇文泰由此崛起，北魏终至分裂。

summary.en: The defector Hou Jing rebelled against Liang, besieged Jiankang's palace city and starved Emperor Wu to death. The war ruined the Yangtze delta until Wang Sengbian and Chen Baxian destroyed him.
summary.zh: 东魏降将侯景叛梁，围攻建康台城，梁武帝饿死。江南残破，至552年王僧辩、陈霸先平之。

summary.en: Yang Jian, regent for a child emperor of Northern Zhou, took the throne as Emperor Wen of Sui, built the new capital Daxing beside old Chang'an and issued the Kaihuang code; in 589 he conquered Chen.
summary.zh: 北周外戚杨坚受禅称帝建隋，营建大兴城，颁《开皇律》，确立三省六部制，589年灭陈统一。

story.en:
Yang Jian, Duke of Sui, was the father-in-law of Northern Zhou's erratic Emperor Xuan. When Xuan died suddenly in 580, Yang's allies at court forged a decree making him regent for the seven-year-old Emperor Jing. He crushed a rebellion by the general Yuchi Jiong within months, and in March 581 the child "abdicated." Yang Jian became Emperor Wen of Sui and had the Zhou imperial princes put to death.

He built fast. The architect Yuwen Kai laid out a vast new grid capital, Daxing, beside the decayed Han city of Chang'an; the Kaihuang code simplified the laws; the three departments and six ministries became the frame of central government; and officials were recruited more by examination and recommendation than by birth. His empress, Dugu Qieluo, was an unusually powerful political partner.

In 589 Sui armies under the nominal command of his son Yang Guang crossed the Yangtze. Han Qinhu and He Ruobi took Jiankang, and the last Chen ruler, Chen Shubao, was dragged out of a palace well where he had hidden with two consorts. After nearly three hundred years of division, China was one again.
story.zh:
隋国公杨坚是北周宣帝的岳父。580年宣帝暴卒，杨坚的亲信伪造遗诏，使他以外戚身份辅佐年仅七岁的周静帝。他在数月内平定尉迟迥之乱，581年三月静帝“禅让”，杨坚即位为隋文帝，随即诛杀北周宗室诸王。

文帝锐意建设：命宇文恺在破败的汉长安城旁规划营建棋盘式的新都大兴城；颁行《开皇律》删繁就简；确立三省六部制为中央政府框架；选官更多依靠考试和举荐而非门第。独孤皇后也是他极为重要的政治伙伴。

589年，隋军在晋王杨广统领下渡江伐陈，韩擒虎、贺若弼攻入建康，陈后主陈叔宝与两位妃嫔藏身宫中枯井，被拽出俘虏。历经近三百年分裂，中国重归统一。

name.en: Construction of the Sui Grand Canal

summary.en: Emperor Yang linked Luoyang to the Huai and Yangtze by the Tongji Canal (605), to Zhuojun near Beijing by the Yongji Canal (608), and to Hangzhou by the Jiangnan Canal (610), creating China's north-south artery.
summary.zh: 隋炀帝相继开通济渠（605）、永济渠（608）、江南河（610），以洛阳为中心北抵涿郡、南达余杭，贯通南北水运。

story.en:
Emperor Yang came to the throne in 604 and the next year ordered the Tongji Canal, linking Luoyang through the Bian River to the Huai, with an older channel extended on to the Yangtze at Jiangdu (Yangzhou). The Sui shu says more than a million men and women were conscripted for it. In 608 the Yongji Canal ran north to Zhuojun near modern Beijing, again with over a million labourers, so many that women had to be drafted; in 610 the Jiangnan Canal carried the system south to Yuhang (Hangzhou).

The canals had military as well as economic purposes: grain and troops moved north on the Yongji for the disastrous Goguryeo wars of 612–614. Emperor Yang also travelled them in splendour, his four-decked dragon boat leading a flotilla said to stretch for miles, which later historians made a symbol of his extravagance.

The exhausted population rose in revolt, and the emperor was killed at Jiangdu in 618. Yet the waterways outlasted the dynasty: the Tang poet Pi Rixiu wrote that people blamed this river for Sui's fall, yet a thousand li still depended on it. Rerouted under the Yuan, the Grand Canal became a UNESCO World Heritage site in 2014.
story.zh:
隋炀帝604年即位，次年下令开凿通济渠，自洛阳经汴水通淮河，并疏浚邗沟直达江都（扬州）长江边。《隋书》载此役征发河南诸郡男女百余万。608年又开永济渠，北通涿郡（今北京附近），征发河北民工百余万，男丁不足，竟以妇女服役；610年再开江南河，南抵余杭（杭州）。

运河兼有军事与经济用途：612至614年征讨高句丽时，粮草和兵员都经永济渠北运。炀帝也乘运河巡游，四层龙舟领头，船队绵延二百余里，后世史家视之为其奢靡的象征。

民力耗竭，天下大乱，618年炀帝在江都被弑。但运河比王朝长久：唐代皮日休写道“尽道隋亡为此河，至今千里赖通波”。经元代截弯取直后，大运河于2014年列入《世界遗产名录》。

summary.en: After Emperor Yang was killed at Jiangdu, Li Yuan, who had risen at Taiyuan and taken the capital, accepted the abdication of the puppet Emperor Gong and proclaimed the Tang dynasty at Chang'an.
summary.zh: 隋炀帝江都遇弑后，太原起兵入据长安的李渊迫隋恭帝禅位，于长安称帝建唐。

story.en:
Li Yuan, Duke of Tang, was a cousin of the Sui imperial family and commander at Taiyuan when the empire disintegrated after Emperor Yang's Korean wars. In the summer of 617, with his sons Li Jiancheng and Li Shimin and after securing an understanding with the Eastern Turks, he raised his army. His daughter, later Princess Pingyang, recruited her own force, remembered as the "Army of the Lady."

Li Yuan marched down the Fen valley, crossed the Yellow River and took Chang'an in late 617. There he placed Emperor Yang's grandson Yang You on the throne and declared the absent emperor "retired." When news came that Yuwen Huaji had strangled Emperor Yang at Jiangdu in the spring of 618, Li Yuan accepted Yang You's abdication and proclaimed the Tang dynasty, with the reign title Wude.

Tang was then one regime among many. Over the next six years Li Shimin crushed the Xue family's state in the northwest and, in 621, captured both Wang Shichong at Luoyang and Dou Jiande at Hulao Pass in a single campaign. The prestige he won there would soon set him against his elder brother.
story.zh:
唐国公李渊是隋朝皇室的表亲，隋炀帝三征高句丽后天下大乱时，他正任太原留守。617年夏，他与儿子李建成、李世民在与东突厥达成默契后起兵；其女（后来的平阳公主）也自募兵马，号称“娘子军”。

李渊沿汾河南下，西渡黄河，于617年冬攻入长安，立炀帝之孙杨侑为帝，遥尊炀帝为太上皇。618年春，宇文化及在江都缢杀炀帝，消息传来后，李渊接受杨侑禅位，建立唐朝，年号武德。

当时唐朝只是群雄之一。此后六年间，李世民先在西北击灭薛举父子，621年又在一次战役中于洛阳和虎牢关先后擒获王世充与窦建德。他由此赢得的威望，很快使他与兄长走向对立。

summary.en: Li Shimin ambushed and killed his brothers, Crown Prince Li Jiancheng and Li Yuanji, at the Xuanwu Gate of the palace in Chang'an; within two months his father abdicated in his favour.
summary.zh: 秦王李世民在长安宫城玄武门伏兵杀太子建成、齐王元吉，两月后唐高祖传位，李世民即位为唐太宗。

story.en:
After the wars of unification, Li Shimin, Prince of Qin, had his own court of generals and advisers and more glory than his elder brother, the crown prince Li Jiancheng. Jiancheng and their younger brother Li Yuanji tried to strip Shimin of his officers, and the court split into armed camps.

On the night of 1 July 626 Shimin accused his brothers before their father of misconduct with palace consorts, and the emperor summoned all three for the next morning. Shimin posted men at the Xuanwu Gate, the northern entrance to the palace. As Jiancheng and Yuanji rode in and sensed the trap, Shimin shot Jiancheng dead with an arrow; Yuanji was killed by Yuchi Gong. According to the Zizhi tongjian, Yuchi Gong then went, armed, to report to Emperor Gaozu, who was boating on a palace lake, and the emperor had little choice but to accept the outcome.

The brothers' ten sons were executed. Shimin became crown prince three days later and emperor two months after that, ruling as Taizong. Because Taizong later read the official records of his reign, historians have long suspected the account was shaped in his favour.
story.zh:
统一战争结束后，秦王李世民拥有自己的文武幕府，功勋威望远超太子李建成。李建成与四弟齐王李元吉设法剥夺李世民的部属，朝廷分裂为相互戒备的两大集团。

626年7月1日夜，李世民向父亲密奏二人淫乱后宫，唐高祖命三兄弟次日入宫对质。李世民预先在宫城北门玄武门埋伏兵马。次日清晨李建成、李元吉入宫途中察觉有变，李世民一箭射杀建成，元吉被尉迟恭所杀。据《资治通鉴》记载，尉迟恭随后披甲持矛去见正在宫中海池泛舟的高祖，高祖只得接受既成事实。

建成、元吉的十个儿子均被处死。三天后李世民被立为太子，两个月后即位，是为唐太宗。由于太宗曾亲自调阅本朝国史，历代史家多怀疑相关记载经过有利于他的修饰。

name.en: Tang defeat of the Eastern Turks at Yinshan

summary.en: Li Jing's surprise attack in the Yin Mountains destroyed the Eastern Turkic Khaganate; the fleeing Illig Qaghan was captured soon after. The steppe chiefs then hailed Taizong as "Heavenly Khagan".
summary.zh: 李靖率军夜袭阴山，大破东突厥，颉利可汗旋即被唐军擒获。西北诸部尊唐太宗为“天可汗”。

story.en:
In 626, less than three weeks after Taizong's accession, Illig Qaghan of the Eastern Turks brought his horsemen to the Wei River bridge outside Chang'an, and the new emperor Taizong had to ride out and buy peace. He then rebuilt his cavalry and waited. Between 627 and 629 heavy snows killed the Turks' herds, and subject peoples such as the Xueyantuo rebelled.

In the winter of 629–630 Taizong sent Li Jing north. With three thousand cavalry Li Jing took Dingxiang in a night raid. Illig retreated to the Yin Mountains and sent envoys offering to submit, and a Tang envoy was in his camp, yet Li Jing judged the moment too good to lose. Under cover of fog his picked cavalry fell on the Turkish camp, killing about ten thousand and capturing tens of thousands of people. Illig fled and was captured soon after by Zhang Baoxiang.

Brought to Chang'an, Illig was pardoned and given a house. The Zizhi tongjian records that at the victory feast the retired emperor Gaozu played the pipa while Taizong danced. That spring the steppe chiefs hailed Taizong as Tian Kehan, "Heavenly Qaghan," and Tang power reached deep into Inner Asia.
story.zh:
626年，唐太宗即位不到二十天，东突厥颉利可汗率骑兵直抵长安城外的渭水便桥，刚即位的唐太宗被迫亲自出城与之结盟。此后太宗整顿骑兵，等待时机。627至629年间大雪连年，突厥牲畜大量冻死，薛延陀等附属部落纷纷叛离。

629至630年冬，太宗派李靖北伐。李靖率三千骑兵夜袭定襄得手。颉利退至阴山，遣使请降，唐使唐俭正在其营中，但李靖认为良机不可失，趁大雾率精骑突袭突厥牙帐，斩首万余级，俘获男女十余万。颉利逃走，不久被张宝相擒获。

颉利被押至长安后获赦，赐予宅第。《资治通鉴》记载，庆功宴上太上皇李渊亲弹琵琶，太宗起舞助兴。同年春，西北诸部君长共尊太宗为“天可汗”，唐朝势力深入内亚。

summary.en: Emperor Taizong sent Princess Wencheng to Rasa (Lhasa) as consort of the Tibetan emperor Songtsen Gampo, sealing an alliance; tradition credits her with bringing Buddhist images and Chinese crafts to Tibet.
summary.zh: 唐太宗以宗室女文成公主嫁吐蕃赞普松赞干布，唐蕃和亲；相传公主携佛像与工艺入藏。

name.en: Wu Zetian proclaims the Zhou dynasty

summary.en: Having ruled through her sons for years, Empress Wu took the throne herself as emperor of a new Zhou dynasty, with Luoyang as the "Divine Capital" – the only woman to reign as emperor in Chinese history.
summary.zh: 武则天在临朝称制多年后自立为帝，改国号为周，以洛阳为神都，成为中国历史上唯一的女皇帝。

story.en:
Wu Zhao entered the palace as a junior consort of Taizong and, after his death, became a consort of his son Gaozong, who made her empress in 655. When Gaozong suffered a stroke around 660 she increasingly ruled beside him; the court spoke of the "Two Sages." After his death in 683 she deposed her son Zhongzong within two months and kept Ruizong as a figurehead.

She crushed a rising led by Xu Jingye in 684. The histories say that when she read the rebels' manifesto by Luo Binwang, which savaged her character, she asked why a man who wrote so well had been left out of office. To hunt enemies she installed copper boxes for anonymous accusations, and cruel investigators such as Lai Junchen and Zhou Xing ran purges of the Tang royal family.

In the autumn of 690, after Buddhist texts were circulated hailing her as a future sovereign, she proclaimed a new Zhou dynasty, ruling from Luoyang, which she had renamed the Divine Capital in 684, under the name Zhao (曌), a character coined for her the year before. She expanded the examinations and promoted capable officials such as Di Renjie. Forced to abdicate in the coup of 705, she died that year and lies at Qianling beside Gaozong, under a famous uninscribed stele.
story.zh:
武曌最初是唐太宗的才人，太宗去世后成为唐高宗的妃嫔，655年被立为皇后。约660年高宗患风疾，武后逐渐参与朝政，与高宗并称“二圣”。683年高宗去世，次年二月她便废黜中宗，又立睿宗为傀儡。

684年她平定了徐敬业的叛乱。史载她读到骆宾王所作痛斥她的檄文时，反而问宰相：如此人才为何没能任用？为清除异己，她设铜匦接受告密，任用来俊臣、周兴等酷吏大肆诛杀李唐宗室。

690年秋，在宣扬她将君临天下的佛经注疏流传之后，她改唐为周，定都早在684年已改称神都的洛阳；此前一年她已为自己造字取名“曌”。她扩大科举，重用狄仁杰等能臣。705年神龙政变后被迫退位，同年去世，与高宗合葬乾陵，陵前立着著名的无字碑。

summary.en: Frontier general An Lushan rose at Fanyang, took both Tang capitals and proclaimed a Yan dynasty. Emperor Xuanzong fled to Sichuan; Tang, with Uyghur help, needed eight years to suppress the rebels, and never regained its former strength.
summary.zh: 节度使安禄山、史思明自范阳起兵，攻陷两京，僭号大燕；玄宗奔蜀。唐借回纥兵历八年始平定，盛唐由此转衰。

label.en: End of the rebellion at Mozhou

story.en:
An Lushan, a frontier officer of Sogdian and Turkic descent, won the favour of Emperor Xuanzong and his consort Yang Guifei and by 751 commanded three northern military districts with some 150,000 troops. His rivalry with the chief minister Yang Guozhong, the consort's cousin, finally drove him to rebel at Fanyang on 16 December 755, claiming he came to purge Yang Guozhong.

His veterans took Luoyang within weeks, and in 756 he proclaimed himself emperor of Yan. When the court forced Geshu Han out of the stronghold of Tong Pass to fight, his army was destroyed and Xuanzong fled toward Sichuan. At Mawei post station his escort mutinied, killed Yang Guozhong and demanded the death of Yang Guifei; Gao Lishi strangled her in a Buddhist shrine. The crown prince was proclaimed emperor (Suzong) at Lingwu.

The rebels destroyed themselves as much as they were defeated: An Lushan was murdered by his son, and his successor Shi Siming by his. With Uyghur cavalry and loyalists such as Guo Ziyi, the Tang finally won in 763. Registered households fell drastically, military governors became semi-independent, and Du Fu's poems recorded the suffering.
story.zh:
安禄山是粟特与突厥混血的边将，深得唐玄宗与杨贵妃宠信，到751年已身兼平卢、范阳、河东三镇节度使，拥兵约十五万。他与贵妃族兄、宰相杨国忠势同水火，755年12月16日以讨伐杨国忠为名在范阳起兵。

叛军精锐数周即攻陷洛阳，756年安禄山在洛阳称大燕皇帝。朝廷逼迫哥舒翰出潼关迎战，唐军全军覆没，玄宗仓皇西逃入蜀。行至马嵬驿，护驾禁军哗变，杀杨国忠，又要求处死杨贵妃，高力士将她缢死于佛堂。太子李亨在灵武即位，是为唐肃宗。

叛军内部自相残杀：安禄山被其子安庆绪所杀，继起的史思明也死于儿子史朝义之手。唐朝借助回纥骑兵并依靠郭子仪等将领，至763年终于平定叛乱。此后户籍人口锐减，藩镇割据，杜甫以诗记录了这场浩劫中的民生疾苦。

summary.en: Chancellor Yang Yan replaced the per-capita grain, labour and cloth levies with taxes on land and property collected in summer and autumn, a basic shift in Chinese fiscal practice.
summary.zh: 宰相杨炎废租庸调，改按户等资产与田亩于夏秋两季征税，是中国赋税制度的重大转变。

summary.zh: 唐蕃先盟于长安（821），再盟于逻些（822），823年将汉藏双语盟文刻碑立于大昭寺前，至今尚存。

name.en: Zhang Yichao founds the Guiyi Army

summary.en: Zhang Yichao led the people of Shazhou (Dunhuang) in expelling the Tibetan garrison and restored Gua, Sha and other Hexi prefectures to Tang allegiance; the court named his regime the Guiyi ("Return to Allegiance") Army.
summary.zh: 张议潮率沙州军民驱逐吐蕃守将，收复瓜、沙等河西诸州归唐，唐廷置归义军，以其为节度使。

note: The rising was in 848; the Guiyi Army title was granted in 851.

summary.en: Salt smugglers Wang Xianzhi and Huang Chao led a peasant war that swept from Shandong to Guangzhou and back; Huang Chao captured Chang'an in 881 and proclaimed Qi. The rebellion left Tang power in the hands of regional warlords.
summary.zh: 王仙芝、黄巢以私盐贩起事，转战南北远至广州；881年黄巢入长安称帝建齐。唐室自此名存实亡，藩镇坐大。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)

资治通鉴 卷252–256 唐纪

story.en:
In the 870s drought, famine and heavy taxes drove the Yellow River plain to revolt. Wang Xianzhi, a salt smuggler, rose in 874–875, and Huang Chao, another smuggler from Yuanqu who had failed the examinations, joined him. After Wang was killed in 878 Huang Chao led the remnants on an astonishing march south through Jiangxi and Fujian to Guangzhou, which he sacked in 879. Arab writers later claimed that 120,000 foreign merchants died there, a figure that cannot be checked.

Disease drove his army north again. In January 881 he entered Chang'an, Emperor Xizong fled to Sichuan as Xuanzong had done, and Huang Chao proclaimed the state of Qi. The capital suffered terribly; Wei Zhuang's long poem "Lament of the Lady of Qin" describes the imperial treasury burned to ashes of brocade and the bones of high officials trampled in the streets.

In 883 Shatuo Turkic cavalry under Li Keyong drove him out, and in 884 he died near Mount Tai. The real victors were warlords: his former lieutenant Zhu Wen, who had gone over to the Tang, ended the dynasty in 907.
story.zh:
870年代，旱灾、饥荒和苛税使黄河中下游民不聊生。私盐贩王仙芝于874至875年间起事，屡试不第的冤句盐贩黄巢起兵响应。878年王仙芝战死后，黄巢率余部转战江西、福建，一路南下，879年攻破广州。后来的阿拉伯作者称城中有十二万外商遇害，这一数字无从核实。

岭南疫病流行，黄巢回师北上，881年1月（广明元年十二月）攻入长安，唐僖宗仿效玄宗逃往蜀中，黄巢在长安称帝，国号大齐。京城惨遭浩劫，韦庄长诗《秦妇吟》写下“内库烧为锦绣灰，天街踏尽公卿骨”的景象。

883年，沙陀骑兵在李克用率领下将黄巢逐出长安，884年黄巢死于泰山狼虎谷。真正的赢家是军阀：黄巢旧部朱温降唐后坐大，于907年篡唐。

summary.en: To win Khitan support against Later Tang, Shi Jingtang ceded sixteen prefectures around Youzhou (Beijing) and Yunzhou (Datong) to the Liao, giving the steppe empire a foothold south of the Great Wall for four centuries.
summary.zh: 石敬瑭为借契丹兵灭后唐，割幽、云等十六州予辽，自此中原失去长城屏障达四百余年。

薛居正等《旧五代史》卷75 晋书一 高祖纪一
资治通鉴 卷280 后晋纪一 天福元年

story.en:
Shi Jingtang, a Shatuo general and son-in-law of the Later Tang emperor Mingzong, held Taiyuan with a large army. In 936 the emperor Li Congke tried to move him to another post; Shi refused and, besieged, turned to the Khitan ruler Yelü Deguang (Emperor Taizong of Liao). He offered to call himself Deguang's son, though he was ten years older, to send 300,000 bolts of silk a year, and to cede the sixteen prefectures along the northern frontier.

Khitan cavalry broke the Later Tang siege of Taiyuan, and Deguang personally invested Shi as emperor of a new Jin dynasty. As their armies approached Luoyang, Li Congke burned himself to death in a tower with his family. The ceded territory, including Youzhou (modern Beijing) and Yunzhou (Datong), passed to the Liao, which made Youzhou its Southern Capital in 938.

The loss stripped north China of the mountain passes and the Great Wall line that guarded the plain. Song attempts to recover the region failed in 979 and 986, and the prefectures stayed under Liao, Jin and Yuan rule until Ming armies took Beijing in 1368, some four centuries later. Shi Jingtang has been remembered ever since as the "son emperor."
story.zh:
后唐明宗的女婿、沙陀人石敬瑭坐镇太原，手握重兵。936年，后唐末帝李从珂下诏将他移镇，石敬瑭拒命被围，遂向契丹主耶律德光（辽太宗）求援，许诺以子礼事之（尽管他比耶律德光年长十岁），每年输帛三十万匹，并割让北方边境十六州。

契丹骑兵击溃围攻太原的后唐军，耶律德光亲自册立石敬瑭为大晋皇帝。联军逼近洛阳时，李从珂携家人登玄武楼自焚而死。幽州（今北京）、云州（今大同）等十六州从此归辽，938年辽以幽州为南京。

此举使中原失去了屏障华北平原的山川关隘和长城防线。宋朝在979年和986年两次北伐收复失败，十六州历经辽、金、元统治，直到1368年明军攻克大都才重归中原王朝，前后约四百余年。石敬瑭也因此背负“儿皇帝”的骂名。

name.en: Chenqiao Mutiny and founding of Song

summary.en: At Chenqiao post station north of Kaifeng, troops of the Later Zhou palace army draped a yellow robe on their commander Zhao Kuangyin; he returned to the capital, accepted the child emperor's abdication and founded the Song.
summary.zh: 后周殿前都点检赵匡胤于陈桥驿被部下黄袍加身，回师开封受禅，建立宋朝。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
脱脱等《宋史》卷1 太祖本纪一 建隆元年
李焘《续资治通鉴长编》卷1

story.en:
When the able Later Zhou emperor Shizong (Chai Rong) died in 959, he left a seven-year-old heir. Zhao Kuangyin, commander of the palace army, was the most powerful soldier in the realm. On New Year's Day 960 a report arrived, perhaps contrived, that Liao and Northern Han forces were invading, and two days later Zhao led the army out of Kaifeng.

That night at Chenqiao post station, some 20 km northeast of the capital, his officers, with his brother Zhao Kuangyi and the adviser Zhao Pu in the know, plotted to make him emperor. At dawn they draped a yellow robe on him and hailed him with cheers. Song accounts say he accepted only after the troops swore not to harm the Zhou empress dowager and child emperor nor to plunder the capital. The army marched back, met almost no resistance, and the boy emperor abdicated.

Zhao named his dynasty Song after his old command at Songzhou. Knowing how easily he had taken power, he worked to keep generals from repeating the trick; the famous story that in 961 he persuaded his senior commanders over wine to retire with riches comes from later Song anecdotes. The Chai family was protected throughout the dynasty.
story.zh:
959年，英明的后周世宗柴荣病逝，继位的恭帝年仅七岁，殿前都点检赵匡胤成为最有实力的武将。960年正月初一，边境传来辽与北汉联兵入侵的警报（可能出于捏造），初三赵匡胤奉命率军出开封北上。

当夜大军驻扎在京城东北约四十里的陈桥驿，将士们在赵匡义、赵普的知情策划下密谋拥立。次日黎明，众人把黄袍披在赵匡胤身上，罗拜高呼万岁。据宋人记载，他与将士约定不得惊犯后周太后与幼主、不得劫掠京城，方才应允。大军回师开封，几乎未遇抵抗，恭帝禅位。

赵匡胤以其曾任归德军节度使的宋州为国号，建立宋朝。他深知兵变夺权之易，竭力防止武将效法；著名的“杯酒释兵权”故事出自宋人笔记，细节或有渲染。柴氏子孙在整个宋代都受到优待。

summary.en: After a Liao invasion reached Chanzhou on the Yellow River, Emperor Zhenzong, urged on by Kou Zhun, agreed peace: Song paid annual silk and silver, and the two empires kept the peace for over a century.
summary.zh: 辽萧太后与圣宗南下至澶州，寇准力劝宋真宗亲征，双方议和：宋岁输辽银绢，宋辽此后百余年无大战。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
脱脱等《宋史》卷7 真宗本纪二 景德元年
李焘《续资治通鉴长编》卷58

note: Jiangshan-map uses 1004 (Jingde 1, 12th month); the oath was exchanged in January 1005 (Julian), the year Wikidata gives.

story.en:
In the autumn of 1004 the Liao Empress Dowager Xiao (Xiao Chuo) and her son Emperor Shengzong led a great army south, bypassing fortified towns and reaching Chanzhou on the Yellow River, only a few days' ride from Kaifeng. Some Song ministers urged Emperor Zhenzong to flee to Jinling or Chengdu; the chief councillor Kou Zhun insisted he go to the front instead.

Zhenzong crossed to the northern city of Chanzhou, where the sight of his banners cheered the troops. A Song crossbow bolt killed the Liao general Xiao Talin, and both sides, far from their bases, preferred talks. The envoy Cao Liyong was told by the emperor he might concede up to a million in payments; Kou Zhun privately warned him he would be beheaded if he gave more than 300,000. The treaty of January 1005 set annual Song payments of 100,000 taels of silver and 200,000 bolts of silk, and made the two rulers "brothers."

Critics later called it a humiliating pact signed beneath the city walls, and Kou Zhun was soon dismissed. Yet the payments were small beside Song revenue and recovered through border trade, and the peace lasted more than a century.
story.zh:
1004年秋，辽承天太后萧绰与辽圣宗率大军南下，绕过坚城，直抵黄河边的澶州，距开封仅数日路程。宋廷有大臣主张宋真宗南逃金陵或西奔成都，宰相寇准则坚持请皇帝亲征。

真宗渡河登上澶州北城，宋军望见黄龙旗，士气大振。辽军大将萧挞凛被宋军床子弩射杀，双方都远离后方，转而议和。真宗对使臣曹利用说岁币即使百万也可答应，寇准却私下警告他超过三十万就要斩首。1005年1月订立和约：宋每年给辽银十万两、绢二十万匹，两国皇帝以兄弟相称。

后来有人指责这是“城下之盟”，寇准不久即遭罢相。但岁币与宋朝财政收入相比数额有限，又可通过榷场贸易收回，宋辽之间保持了一百多年的和平。

summary.en: The Song state took over the privately issued jiaozi notes of Sichuan merchants and set up an official Jiaozi bureau at Yizhou (Chengdu), creating the world's first government paper currency.
summary.zh: 北宋于益州（成都）设交子务，将四川商人私发的交子收归官办，成为世界上最早的官方纸币。

summary.en: The Tangut leader Li Yuanhao declared himself emperor of Great Xia at Xingqing (Yinchuan), introduced a Tangut script, and fought Song to a standstill before the Qingli peace of 1044.
summary.zh: 党项首领李元昊于兴庆府称帝，国号大夏，创制西夏文；与宋连年交战，1044年订庆历和议。

summary.en: Emperor Shenzong backed Wang Anshi's reforms – state loans to farmers, hired labour service, militia and trade measures – to enrich the state. Opponents led by Sima Guang reversed them in 1085–86, opening decades of factional strife.
summary.zh: 宋神宗任用王安石推行青苗、免役、保甲、市易等新法以富国强兵；1085年后司马光等尽废新法，新旧党争延续数十年。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
脱脱等《宋史》卷327 王安石传
Britannica: Wang Anshi

story.en:
Wang Anshi had argued since his "Ten-Thousand-Word Memorial" of 1058 that the Song state was rich in officials but poor in revenue and weak in arms. In 1069 the twenty-year-old Emperor Shenzong made him vice chief councillor, and chief councillor the next year. A new planning commission launched reform after reform: Green Sprouts loans to farmers at planting time, cash payments replacing compulsory labour service, the baojia mutual-security militia, state trade and price-stabilising bureaus, a land survey for fairer taxes, and changes to the examinations.

Opposition was fierce. Sima Guang, Su Shi, Han Qi and Ouyang Xiu attacked the loans as usury by the state, and critics put in Wang's mouth the slogan that heaven's portents need not be feared nor ancestral rules followed. In 1074, during a drought, a minor official presented a painting of starving refugees to the emperor, and Wang was briefly dismissed; he retired to Jiangning (Nanjing) in 1076.

After Shenzong died in 1085, the regent Empress Dowager Gao recalled Sima Guang, who abolished nearly everything; both men died in 1086. The reforms were later revived in harsher form, and the feud between reform and anti-reform factions poisoned court politics until the fall of Kaifeng.
story.zh:
王安石自1058年上《万言书》起便主张：宋朝官多而财匮、兵众而不强。1069年，二十岁的宋神宗任命他为参知政事（次年拜相），设置制置三司条例司，推行一系列新法：青苗法在春耕时向农户放贷，免役法以纳钱代替差役，保甲法组织民兵，市易法、均输法由官府经营贸易、平抑物价，方田均税法清丈土地，并改革科举。

反对声浪极大。司马光、苏轼、韩琦、欧阳修等人抨击青苗法是官府放高利贷；反对者还把“天变不足畏，祖宗不足法，人言不足恤”的说法归于王安石。1074年大旱，小吏郑侠向神宗献上《流民图》，王安石一度罢相，1076年退居江宁（南京）。

1085年神宗去世，高太后听政，起用司马光，几乎尽废新法；次年王安石与司马光相继去世。新法后来以更严苛的形式恢复，新旧党争延续不断，直至北宋灭亡。

summary.en: After nineteen years of work, Sima Guang presented the 294-chapter Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance, a chronicle from 403 BCE to 959 CE, to Emperor Shenzong.
summary.zh: 司马光历时十九年编成294卷编年体通史《资治通鉴》，起战国三家分晋（前403）迄五代（959），进呈宋神宗。

司马光《进资治通鉴表》
脱脱等《宋史》卷336 司马光传

summary.en: Jin armies invaded Song in 1125, besieged Kaifeng twice and took it in early 1127, carrying off the emperors Huizong and Qinzong and thousands of courtiers. Prince Zhao Gou re-established the dynasty at Yingtian as the Southern Song.
summary.zh: 金军1125年分两路南下，两围东京，1127年初攻破开封，掳徽、钦二帝及宗室北去，北宋亡；康王赵构于应天府即位，建立南宋。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
脱脱等《宋史》卷23 钦宗本纪 靖康二年
徐梦莘《三朝北盟会编》

story.en:
In 1120 Song allied with the rising Jurchen state of Jin against Liao, but its own armies failed to take Yanjing (Beijing), and Jin, having captured it, sold it back for a large ransom. The Jurchen drew their own conclusions about Song weakness. In late 1125, with Liao destroyed, Jin generals Wanyan Zonghan and Wanyan Zongwang invaded in two columns. The panicked Emperor Huizong abdicated in favour of his son Qinzong.

The minister Li Gang defended Kaifeng through the first siege in early 1126, which ended with promises to cede three northern prefectures. Song reneged, and Jin returned that winter. As the capital's defences crumbled, the court trusted a charlatan named Guo Jing, who claimed he could rout the enemy with "divine troops" raised by magic; when he opened a gate to send them out, they were cut down and the Jurchen poured in.

In the spring of 1127 Jin carried Huizong, Qinzong, empresses, princes and thousands of palace women, artisans and officials north to Manchuria, along with the imperial collections. Huizong died in captivity in 1135. Prince Zhao Gou, who had been outside the city, took the throne at Yingtian (Shangqiu) in June 1127 and founded the Southern Song.
story.zh:
1120年宋金订立“海上之盟”夹攻辽国，但宋军未能攻下燕京，金军攻取后又以重金“卖还”宋朝。女真人由此看清宋朝的虚弱。1125年冬，辽亡之后，金将完颜宗翰、完颜宗望分两路南下。惊慌失措的宋徽宗传位于太子，是为宋钦宗。

1126年初，李纲率军民守住了开封，第一次围城以宋朝许割太原、中山、河间三镇而结束。宋廷事后反悔，金军当年冬再度南下。城防危急之际，朝廷竟听信骗子郭京以“六甲神兵”退敌之说。郭京打开城门出战，“神兵”一触即溃，金军乘势攻入城中。

1127年春，金军掳走徽、钦二帝及后妃、宗室，连同数以千计的宫女、工匠和官员北去，宫中图籍文物也被搜刮一空。徽宗1135年死于五国城。当时在外的康王赵构于1127年6月在应天府（今商丘）即位，建立南宋。

summary.en: Chancellor Qin Hui recalled Yue Fei from his northern offensive, had him imprisoned and killed, and concluded peace with Jin: Song became a vassal paying tribute, with the border fixed along the Huai River and Dasan Pass.
summary.zh: 秦桧召回北伐的岳飞并构陷致死，与金订立和约：宋向金称臣纳贡，以淮河至大散关为界。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
脱脱等《宋史》卷29 高宗本纪六 绍兴十一年
李心传《建炎以来系年要录》卷142

story.en:
In 1140 Yue Fei's army won victories at Yancheng and Yingchang and advanced toward Kaifeng, while other Song commanders also pressed north. Emperor Gaozong and his chancellor Qin Hui, however, wanted peace with Jin, which offered to return the emperor's captive mother. According to the Song shi, Yue Fei received twelve gold-lettered recall orders in a single day and withdrew, lamenting that ten years of effort had been thrown away.

In 1141 Qin Hui stripped the leading generals of their commands. Yue Fei was arrested on charges of planning a mutiny. When the general Han Shizhong demanded evidence, Qin Hui is said to have answered that it "need not be" proven (moxuyou), a phrase that became a byword for trumped-up charges. Peace was agreed late in 1141, and Yue Fei was put to death in prison in Lin'an in January 1142.

Under the treaty the Song emperor called himself a vassal of Jin and paid 250,000 taels of silver and 250,000 bolts of silk a year, with the border along the Huai River and Dasan Pass. Gaozong's mother came home with Huizong's coffin. Yue Fei was rehabilitated in 1162, and kneeling iron figures of Qin Hui, his wife and two accomplices still face his tomb in Hangzhou.
story.zh:
1140年，岳飞在郾城、颍昌接连大捷，兵锋直指开封，其他宋将也相继北进。然而宋高宗与宰相秦桧一心求和，金朝则答应送还高宗被掳的生母。据《宋史》记载，岳飞一日之内接到十二道金字牌班师诏令，只得撤军，悲叹“十年之力，废于一旦”。

1141年，秦桧收夺诸大将兵权，岳飞以谋反罪名下狱。韩世忠质问证据何在，秦桧答以“莫须有”，此语后来成为罗织罪名的代称。同年底宋金议和告成，1142年1月岳飞在临安大理寺狱中被害。

和约规定宋向金称臣，每年纳银二十五万两、绢二十五万匹，东以淮河、西以大散关为界。高宗生母韦太后随徽宗灵柩南归。1162年岳飞获平反，至今杭州岳王庙前仍跪着秦桧夫妇及万俟卨、张俊四人的铁像。

summary.en: When Jin emperor Hailing tried to cross the Yangtze, the official Yu Yunwen rallied leaderless Song troops at Caishi; paddle-wheel warships and incendiary weapons defeated the crossing, and Hailing was soon murdered by his officers.
summary.zh: 金海陵王完颜亮南侵欲渡长江，文臣虞允文于采石收拾散兵，以车船与霹雳炮击败金军渡江；不久海陵王为部下所杀。

脱脱等《宋史》卷383 虞允文传

name.en: Siege of Caizhou and fall of Jin

summary.en: Mongol and Southern Song armies besieged the last Jin emperor Aizong at Caizhou. He abdicated and killed himself as the city fell in February 1234, ending the Jin dynasty and bringing Song and the Mongols into direct conflict.
summary.zh: 蒙宋联军围攻蔡州，金哀宗传位后自缢，1234年城破金亡；宋蒙随即接壤开战。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
脱脱等《金史》卷18 哀宗本纪下

story.en:
By 1232 the Jin dynasty was dying. At Sanfengshan in Henan, Mongol forces under Tolui destroyed its last great field army in a snowstorm, and Subutai besieged Kaifeng while plague ravaged the city. Emperor Aizong broke out, wandered to Guide (Shangqiu) and in 1233 took refuge at Caizhou (modern Runan), hoping to rebuild resistance.

The Southern Song, remembering the Jingkang humiliation, joined the Mongols. In late 1233 the Song general Meng Gong arrived with troops and hundreds of thousands of bushels of grain, and the allies surrounded Caizhou. As the city starved through the winter, Aizong passed the throne to his marshal Wanyan Chenglin, saying he himself was too fat to escape on horseback. On 9 February 1234 the walls were breached; Aizong hanged himself, and Chenglin was killed in the fighting the same day after a reign of a few hours.

Meng Gong and the Mongol commander divided Aizong's remains as trophies. That summer Song armies tried to seize Kaifeng and Luoyang, which the Mongols claimed; the venture failed, and within a year the former allies were at war, a conflict that lasted forty-five years.
story.zh:
到1232年，金朝已奄奄一息。拖雷率蒙古军在河南三峰山趁大雪歼灭金军最后的主力，速不台随即围攻汴京，城中瘟疫流行。金哀宗突围出城，辗转至归德（今商丘），1233年退守蔡州（今汝南），图谋重整旗鼓。

南宋念及靖康之耻，与蒙古联手灭金。1233年冬，宋将孟珙率军携带大批粮草赶到，宋蒙联军合围蔡州。城中粮尽，哀宗自称体胖不便骑马突围，传位于东面元帅完颜承麟。1234年2月9日城破，哀宗自缢身亡，承麟即位不过数个时辰便死于乱军之中。

孟珙与蒙古将领瓜分了哀宗遗骨作为战利品。同年夏，宋军出兵收复汴京、洛阳（史称“端平入洛”），与蒙古发生冲突并失败。不到一年，昔日盟友兵戎相见，宋蒙战争持续了四十五年。

summary.en: The mountain fortress of Diaoyucheng near Hechuan held out against the army of the Great Khan Möngke, who died during the siege; his death halted the Mongol offensive on Song and set off a succession struggle.
summary.zh: 合州钓鱼城据险坚守，蒙哥汗亲征死于城下，蒙古攻宋暂停，并引发汗位之争。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
宋濂等《元史》卷3 宪宗本纪 九年

story.en:
After the Mongol devastation of Sichuan in the 1230s, the Song commander Yu Jie built a network of fortified towns on mountain tops and river bluffs. The strongest was Diaoyucheng, raised in 1243 on a hill above the confluence of the Jialing, Qu and Fu rivers near Hechuan, with walls, wells and fields inside.

In 1258 the Great Khan Möngke led the main Mongol offensive against Song into Sichuan in person, and early in 1259 he reached Diaoyucheng. Its commander Wang Jian rejected demands to surrender and executed the envoy. For months the Mongols assaulted the walls and failed. In August 1259 Möngke died in his camp; Chinese accounts link his death to wounds from the defenders, while the Persian historian Rashid al-Din says he died of dysentery.

The death of the Great Khan had effects far beyond Sichuan. Kublai, besieging Ezhou on the Yangtze, made a truce and hurried north to fight his brother Ariq Böke for the throne, and Hülegü withdrew most of his army from Syria. Diaoyucheng itself held out until 1279, after the Song had fallen, surrendering on a promise that its people would be spared.
story.zh:
13世纪30年代蒙古军蹂躏四川之后，南宋四川制置使余玠依山傍水修筑山城防御体系，其中最坚固的是1243年在合州嘉陵江、渠江、涪江交汇处山上建成的钓鱼城，城内有水井和田地，可长期坚守。

1258年，蒙古大汗蒙哥亲率主力攻宋入川，1259年初兵临钓鱼城。守将王坚拒绝招降，斩杀来使。蒙古军连续数月攻城不下。1259年8月蒙哥死于军营中，汉文史料多将其死因与守军的打击联系在一起，波斯史家拉施特则记载他死于痢疾。

大汗之死影响远超四川。正在围攻鄂州的忽必烈与南宋议和，匆忙北返与弟弟阿里不哥争夺汗位；西征的旭烈兀也从叙利亚撤回大部分军队。钓鱼城本身一直坚守到1279年南宋灭亡之后，才以保全城中军民为条件开城投降。

summary.en: For six years Mongol-Yuan forces blockaded the twin Han River fortresses of Xiangyang and Fancheng; counterweight trebuchets built by Muslim engineers finally forced Lü Wenhuan to surrender in 1273, opening the Yangtze to the Yuan.
summary.zh: 元军围困汉水两岸的襄阳、樊城六年，借回回炮破樊城，1273年吕文焕以襄阳降，长江门户洞开。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
宋濂等《元史》卷128 阿术传
脱脱等《宋史》卷46 度宗本纪

story.en:
Xiangyang and Fancheng faced each other across the Han River, guarding the route from the north to the middle Yangtze. Acting on advice from the Song defector Liu Zheng, Kublai's general Aju began a blockade in 1268, building forts and river barriers to cut the twin cities off. Inside, the Song commander Lü Wenhuan had grain but no relief.

The court under Jia Sidao sent too little help, and reportedly kept the emperor uninformed. In 1272 the militia leaders Zhang Shun and Zhang Gui led three thousand volunteers in boats through the blockade with salt and cloth; Zhang Shun's body was later found floating in the river, still in armour. The decisive change came when the Ilkhan sent Kublai two Muslim engineers, Ismail and Ala al-Din, who built large counterweight trebuchets, the "Muslim catapults." Fancheng fell early in 1273, and a stone that crashed into a tower of Xiangyang persuaded Lü Wenhuan to surrender.

Marco Polo later claimed that he, his father and his uncle had built the engines, but they reached China only in 1275. With Xiangyang taken, Bayan's army descended the Yangtze, and the Song capital Lin'an surrendered in 1276.
story.zh:
襄阳、樊城隔汉水相望，扼守由北方进入长江中游的咽喉。元将阿术采纳南宋降将刘整的建议，自1268年起筑城立堡、横江设障，切断两城与外界的联系。守将吕文焕城中有粮，却等不来援军。

朝中权臣贾似道援救不力，据说还向度宗隐瞒军情。1272年，民兵首领张顺、张贵率三千民兵驾船冲破封锁，运进盐和布匹，张顺战死，尸体披甲持弓浮于江上。转折出现在伊利汗国派来两名回回工匠亦思马因和阿老瓦丁，为忽必烈制造了巨型配重投石机，即“回回炮”。1273年初樊城陷落，一颗巨石击中襄阳城楼，声如雷震，吕文焕遂以城降。

马可·波罗日后声称投石机是他和父亲、叔父所造，但他们1275年才到中国。襄阳既下，伯颜率大军顺江东下，1276年南宋都城临安投降。

name.en: Kublai Khan proclaims the Yuan dynasty

summary.en: Having won the succession war against his brother Ariq Böke, Kublai Khan adopted the Chinese dynastic name Da Yuan, taken from the Book of Changes, and made Dadu (Beijing) his capital.
summary.zh: 忽必烈战胜阿里不哥后，取《易经》“大哉乾元”之义建国号大元，定都大都。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
宋濂等《元史》卷7 世祖本纪四 至元八年
Britannica: Yuan dynasty

note: The QID is the zh.wikipedia item for the edict itself (建国号诏, issued 18 December 1271); Q7313 denotes the state and is linked from polity-yuan.

story.en:
When the Great Khan Möngke died in 1259, his brothers Kublai and Ariq Böke each had themselves proclaimed khan, Kublai at Kaiping in Inner Mongolia and Ariq Böke at Karakorum. Kublai, controlling the grain and workshops of north China, won the civil war by 1264, but the western khanates no longer obeyed the Great Khan in practice.

Kublai turned his power base into a Chinese-style state. Advised by the monk-statesman Liu Bingzhong, he made Kaiping his summer capital, Shangdu, and in 1267 began building a vast new city beside the old Jin capital Zhongdu. On 18 December 1271 he issued an edict taking the dynastic name Da Yuan, drawn from a phrase in the Book of Changes praising the primal force of heaven. It was the first Chinese dynastic name taken from an abstract idea rather than a place or fief. In 1272 the new city was named Dadu, "Great Capital," the ancestor of Beijing.

After the fall of Song in 1279 the Yuan became the first non-Han dynasty to rule all of China. Kublai's Chinese ways, however, alienated steppe conservatives, and his kinsman Kaidu, a grandson of Ögedei, fought him in Central Asia for decades.
story.zh:
1259年蒙哥汗去世后，其弟忽必烈和阿里不哥分别在开平（今内蒙古境内）和哈拉和林被拥立为大汗。掌握华北粮食和工匠资源的忽必烈到1264年赢得内战，但西方诸汗国此后实际上已不再听命于大汗。

忽必烈着手把自己的根据地改造成中原式王朝。在僧人出身的谋臣刘秉忠辅佐下，他将开平升为上都，1267年又在金中都旧城东北营建新城。1271年12月18日，他颁布《建国号诏》，取《易经》“大哉乾元”之义定国号为“大元”。这是中国历史上第一个不以封地或地名、而以抽象含义命名的国号。1272年新城定名大都，即今北京的前身。

1279年南宋灭亡后，元朝成为第一个统治全中国的非汉族王朝。但忽必烈的汉化举措引起草原守旧势力不满，其堂侄海都在中亚与他对抗了数十年。

summary.en: The last Song fleet, chained together in the Yamen estuary west of Macau, was destroyed by the Yuan admiral Zhang Hongfan; Lu Xiufu leapt into the sea with the child emperor Zhao Bing, ending the Song dynasty.
summary.zh: 南宋残余船队于崖山海口连舟结阵，被元将张弘范击破，陆秀夫负幼帝赵昺投海，宋亡。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
脱脱等《宋史》卷47 瀛国公纪附二王
宋濂等《元史》卷156 张弘范传

story.en:
After Lin'an surrendered in 1276, loyalists led by Lu Xiufu, Zhang Shijie and Chen Yizhong carried two young princes south. The elder, Zhao Shi, was enthroned at Fuzhou and died in 1278 while the court fled from island to island; his half-brother Zhao Bing, aged about seven, was made emperor and the court settled at Yamen, a sheltered estuary in modern Xinhui.

Zhang Shijie lashed more than a thousand ships together into a floating fortress. The Yuan commander Zhang Hongfan, himself a northern Chinese, blockaded it, cutting off fresh water and firewood. Aboard his fleet was the captured Song chancellor Wen Tianxiang, who refused to write to Zhang Shijie urging surrender and instead composed his poem "Crossing the Lingding Sea," ending with the vow to leave a loyal heart shining in the annals.

On 19 March 1279 the Yuan attacked from north and south and broke the line. According to the Song shi, Lu Xiufu, seeing all was lost, took the boy emperor on his back and leapt into the sea; the same history says more than a hundred thousand bodies floated up in the days that followed. Zhang Shijie escaped but drowned in a storm, and the Song dynasty was over.
story.zh:
1276年临安投降后，陆秀夫、张世杰、陈宜中等人护送两位年幼的皇子南逃。年长的赵昰在福州即位，在海上辗转流亡中于1278年病死；其弟、年仅七八岁的赵昺被立为帝，朝廷移驻新会崖山，那里是一处有山环抱的海湾。

张世杰把一千余艘战船用绳索连在一起，结成水上营垒。元军统帅张弘范本是北方汉人，他率军封锁海口，断绝宋军的淡水和柴薪。被俘的南宋丞相文天祥就在元军船上，他拒绝写信招降张世杰，写下《过零丁洋》，以“人生自古谁无死，留取丹心照汗青”明志。

1279年3月19日，元军南北夹击，突破宋军船阵。据《宋史》记载，陆秀夫见大势已去，背负幼帝投海殉国；又载此后数日海上浮尸十余万。张世杰突围后在风暴中溺亡，宋朝至此灭亡。

summary.en: Conscripted labourers repairing the Yellow River rose under the White Lotus leaders Han Shantong and Liu Futong at Yingzhou. The red-turbaned armies spread across the Yuan realm; one of their commanders, Zhu Yuanzhang, founded the Ming.
summary.zh: 元末征发民夫治黄河，韩山童、刘福通以白莲教在颍州起事，红巾军遍及各地，其部将朱元璋终建明朝。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
宋濂等《元史》卷42 顺帝本纪五 至正十一年
张廷玉等《明史》卷122 韩林儿传

story.en:
In 1351 the Yuan chancellor Toghto conscripted some 150,000 labourers and 20,000 soldiers to repair the Yellow River, which had broken its banks. The White Lotus leader Han Shantong, claiming descent from the Song emperor Huizong, preached that the Maitreya Buddha was coming. According to accounts recorded under the Ming, his followers buried a one-eyed stone figure in the riverbed with a verse prophesying that when it was dug up the empire would rise in revolt.

Han Shantong was caught and killed before the rising, but his partner Liu Futong rose at Yingzhou in May 1351. Its fighters wore red headcloths. Other red-turban armies followed under Xu Shouhui in the middle Yangtze and Guo Zixing at Haozhou, and in 1355 Liu Futong enthroned Han Shantong's son Han Lin'er as the "Young Prince of Radiance" of a restored Song. Northern red-turban columns took Kaifeng in 1358, burned the summer capital Shangdu and raided as far as Korea.

Yuan armies and local militias beat the northern branch down by 1363. Han Lin'er drowned in the Yangtze in 1366 while being escorted by Zhu Yuanzhang's men, an accident many historians doubt. Zhu, who had joined Guo Zixing's red turbans in 1352, inherited the movement and founded the Ming.
story.zh:
1351年，元朝丞相脱脱征发民夫约十五万、士兵两万治理决口的黄河。白莲教首领韩山童自称宋徽宗八世孙，宣扬“弥勒降生”。据明代成书的记载，其徒众在河道中预埋一只眼的石人，背刻“莫道石人一只眼，挑动黄河天下反”。

韩山童在起事前被捕遇害，同伴刘福通于1351年五月在颍州起兵，部众头裹红巾，号称红巾军。徐寿辉在长江中游、郭子兴在濠州等地相继响应。1355年刘福通拥立韩山童之子韩林儿为“小明王”，国号宋。北方红巾军于1358年攻占汴梁，焚毁元上都，甚至进入高丽。

到1363年，北方红巾军已被元军和地方武装镇压。1366年韩林儿在朱元璋部将护送下渡江时于瓜步沉船溺死，许多史家怀疑并非意外。1352年投奔郭子兴的朱元璋继承了红巾军的事业，最终建立明朝。

summary.en: In one of history's largest naval battles, Zhu Yuanzhang's smaller fleet used fire ships to defeat the giant tower ships of his rival Chen Youliang, who was killed; the victory made Zhu master of the Yangtze.
summary.zh: 朱元璋以较小船队用火攻大破陈友谅巨舰于鄱阳湖，陈友谅中箭身亡，朱元璋自此称雄长江中下游。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
张廷玉等《明史》卷1 太祖本纪一

note: The Wikidata item dates it 30 Aug–4 Oct 1363.

story.en:
By 1363 the two strongest powers on the Yangtze were Zhu Yuanzhang at Nanjing and Chen Youliang, who had murdered his own master Xu Shouhui and proclaimed a Han dynasty upriver. While Zhu was away in the north, Chen sailed down with a huge fleet of multi-decked tower ships, some said to carry stables and to be sheathed in iron, and besieged Hongdu (Nanchang). Zhu's nephew Zhu Wenzheng held the city for eighty-five days.

Zhu Yuanzhang came to relieve it, and in late August the fleets met on Lake Poyang. The Ming shi puts Chen's force at 600,000 men and Zhu's at 200,000; even if inflated, Chen's ships were far larger. Zhu's smaller, faster vessels used fire boats packed with gunpowder and reeds, sent downwind into Chen's crowded line, and burned much of it. Fighting went on for weeks as Chen's fleet was trapped in the lake.

In early October, trying to break out to the Yangtze at Hukou, Chen Youliang was killed by an arrow, and his army surrendered. Zhu declared himself King of Wu in 1364, destroyed his remaining rival Zhang Shicheng at Suzhou in 1367, and proclaimed the Ming the following year.
story.zh:
到1363年，长江流域最强的两股势力是据有南京的朱元璋，以及杀害旧主徐寿辉、在上游称帝建“汉”的陈友谅。趁朱元璋北上救援安丰之机，陈友谅率庞大的楼船舰队顺江而下，围攻洪都（今南昌），朱元璋的侄子朱文正坚守八十五天。

朱元璋回师救援，8月底两军在鄱阳湖展开决战。《明史》称陈友谅号六十万，朱元璋二十万，即便有所夸大，陈军战船也远比朱军高大。朱军船小灵活，借风向放出满载火药、芦苇的火船冲入陈军密集的船阵，焚毁大量战船。陈军被困湖中，双方激战三十余日。

10月初，陈友谅企图从湖口突围入江，中流矢身亡，部众投降。朱元璋于1364年称吴王，1367年在苏州消灭最后的劲敌张士诚，次年建立明朝。

summary.en: Zhu Yuanzhang proclaimed the Ming dynasty at Yingtian (Nanjing); in September his generals Xu Da and Chang Yuchun took Dadu, and the last Yuan emperor fled to the steppe.
summary.zh: 朱元璋于应天府称帝建明，同年徐达、常遇春北伐攻克大都，元顺帝北走。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
张廷玉等《明史》卷2 太祖本纪二 洪武元年
Britannica: Ming dynasty

note: No Wikidata item exists for this event itself; Q9903 denotes the state and is linked from polity-ming, so no qid is set here.

story.en:
Zhu Yuanzhang was born to a poor tenant family near Haozhou (Fengyang). In 1344 famine and epidemic killed his parents and eldest brother, and he became a novice at the Huangjue Temple, begging his way across the Huai region when the monks could no longer feed him. In 1352 he joined Guo Zixing's red-turban army, married Guo's adopted daughter, the future Empress Ma, and rose to command.

The Confucian adviser Zhu Sheng gave him a famous maxim: build high walls, store up grain, and be slow to proclaim yourself king. Zhu took Nanjing in 1356, defeated Chen Youliang and Zhang Shicheng, and in 1367 launched a northern expedition with a proclamation calling for the expulsion of the "barbarians" and the restoration of China.

On 23 January 1368 he took the throne at Yingtian (Nanjing), naming his dynasty Ming, "bright," and his reign Hongwu, "vast military power." His generals Xu Da and Chang Yuchun marched up the Grand Canal, and in September the Yuan emperor Toghon Temür abandoned Dadu and fled to the steppe, where his descendants ruled as the Northern Yuan. The beggar-monk had become the founder of a dynasty that lasted 276 years.
story.zh:
朱元璋出身濠州钟离（今凤阳）一个贫苦佃农家庭。1344年旱灾和瘟疫夺去了他父母和长兄的性命，他到皇觉寺出家为僧，寺中断粮后又在淮西一带化缘流浪。1352年他投奔郭子兴的红巾军，娶郭子兴养女马氏（即后来的马皇后），逐渐成为一方统帅。

儒士朱升向他献上“高筑墙，广积粮，缓称王”的九字方略。朱元璋于1356年攻下集庆（南京），先后击灭陈友谅、张士诚，1367年誓师北伐，檄文提出“驱逐胡虏，恢复中华”。

1368年1月23日，朱元璋在应天府（南京）即皇帝位，国号大明，年号洪武。大将徐达、常遇春沿运河北上，同年九月元顺帝妥懽帖睦尔放弃大都北逃草原，其后裔称北元。昔日的乞食僧人成为一个延续二百七十六年王朝的开创者。

summary.en: Zhu Di, Prince of Yan, rebelled at Beiping against his nephew the Jianwen Emperor, who was stripping the princes of power. After three years of war he took Nanjing and enthroned himself as the Yongle Emperor.
summary.zh: 燕王朱棣不满建文帝削藩，于北平起兵“靖难”，历时三年攻入南京，即位为明成祖。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
张廷玉等《明史》卷5 成祖本纪一

story.en:
The Hongwu Emperor's grandson Zhu Yunwen came to the throne in 1398 as the Jianwen Emperor and, advised by Qi Tai and Huang Zicheng, began stripping his uncles of their fiefs. Several princes were demoted or driven to suicide. Zhu Di, Prince of Yan, who commanded the frontier armies at Beiping, reportedly feigned madness to buy time, then rose in August 1399 claiming to "clear away the troubles" (jingnan) around the young emperor.

The war went badly for him at first. The loyal commander Tie Xuan held Jinan against him in 1400, and the Yan army lost heavily at Dongchang. In 1402 Zhu Di changed course, bypassed the fortified cities of Shandong and struck straight for the Yangtze. Li Jinglong and the Prince of Gu opened Nanjing's Jinchuan Gate to him in July; the palace burned and the emperor vanished, giving rise to the enduring legend that he escaped disguised as a monk.

Zhu Di took the throne as the Yongle Emperor. The scholar Fang Xiaoru refused to draft his accession edict and was executed with many kinsmen. Yongle went on to move the capital north and launch Zheng He's fleets.
story.zh:
朱元璋之孙朱允炆于1398年即位，是为建文帝。他采纳齐泰、黄子澄之议，着手削夺诸王封地，数位亲王被废或被逼自尽。坐镇北平、统率北边重兵的燕王朱棣据说一度装疯以拖延时间，于1399年七月起兵，声称要“清君侧、靖国难”。

战事起初对燕军不利：1400年铁铉死守济南，燕军又在东昌大败。1402年朱棣改变方略，绕过山东坚城直趋长江。同年六月，李景隆与谷王朱橞打开南京金川门迎降，宫中起火，建文帝下落不明，由此留下他削发为僧出亡的长久传说。

朱棣即位，是为明成祖永乐帝。方孝孺拒绝为其草拟即位诏书，被处死，亲族门生多受株连（“诛十族”之说出自后世记载）。永乐帝此后迁都北京，并派郑和下西洋。

summary.en: Between 1405 and 1433 the eunuch admiral Zheng He led seven fleets of large treasure ships from Liujiagang through Southeast Asia and the Indian Ocean to Hormuz, Arabia and the East African coast, enrolling dozens of states in the Ming tribute order.
summary.zh: 1405至1433年，郑和七次率宝船队自刘家港出发，经东南亚、印度洋远达忽鲁谟斯、阿拉伯与东非，招徕数十国朝贡。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
张廷玉等《明史》卷304 宦官传一 郑和
马欢《瀛涯胜览》
《天妃灵应之记》碑（长乐，1431）

story.en:
The Yongle Emperor, who had seized the throne by force, wanted the world to acknowledge him. In 1405 he sent the eunuch Zheng He, a Muslim from Yunnan, out of Liujiagang near Suzhou with a fleet that the Ming History numbers at 62 great ships and about 27,800 men. The largest "treasure ships" are recorded as 44 zhang long; how big they really were is still debated.

Over seven voyages the fleets called at Champa, Java, Malacca, Ceylon and Calicut, then sailed on to Hormuz, Aden and the Swahili coast. They were armed diplomacy: in 1407 Zheng He captured the pirate chief Chen Zuyi at Palembang, and in 1411 he carried a Sri Lankan king back to Nanjing. Envoys came to court in return; the giraffe presented in 1414 was hailed at court as a qilin, an auspicious unicorn.

The voyages were enormously expensive and had no successor after Zheng He died on the seventh voyage, probably in 1433. Officials later turned against them. His own words survive mainly in two steles of 1431 at Liujiagang and Changle, which list the voyages and thank the sea goddess Tianfei.
story.zh:
以武力夺得帝位的永乐帝，渴望四方承认其正统。1405年，他派云南回族出身的宦官郑和自苏州附近的刘家港出发，据《明史》记载，船队有大船六十二艘、将士约二万七千八百人。最大的“宝船”长四十四丈，其实际尺寸至今仍有争议。

七次远航中，船队先后到达占城、爪哇、满剌加、锡兰和古里，进而抵达忽鲁谟斯、阿丹和东非斯瓦希里海岸。这是一种带着武力的外交：1407年郑和在旧港擒获海盗首领陈祖义，1411年又将锡兰国王俘回南京。各国使节随之来朝，1414年进献的长颈鹿被朝臣奉为祥瑞“麒麟”。

远航耗费巨大，郑和约于1433年在第七次航行途中去世后便后继无人，朝中大臣也日益反对。他本人留下的文字主要见于1431年所立的刘家港和长乐两通石碑，碑文记述历次航程，并答谢天妃护佑。

summary.en: More than two thousand scholars under Xie Jin and Yao Guangxiao compiled the Yongle Encyclopedia in Nanjing: 22,877 chapters copying some seven to eight thousand earlier works. Only about four percent survives.
summary.zh: 解缙、姚广孝主持两千余人在南京编成《永乐大典》二万二千八百余卷，辑录古籍七八千种，今仅存约百分之四。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
张廷玉等《明史》卷147 解缙传

summary.en: With the Forbidden City completed in 1420, the Yongle Emperor formally made Beijing the principal capital from New Year 1421, leaving Nanjing as the auxiliary capital; Beijing remained the capital until 1928.
summary.zh: 紫禁城于1420年建成，永乐十九年正月明成祖正式迁都北京，以南京为留都；北京此后为都城至1928年。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
张廷玉等《明史》卷7 成祖本纪三 永乐十八年、十九年

note: Q11087884 (zhwiki 永乐迁都) is the relocation itself; the image shows the Forbidden City, completed in 1420.

story.en:
Beiping had been the Yongle Emperor's power base as Prince of Yan, and it lay close to the Mongol frontier he meant to watch. From 1406 he poured resources into rebuilding it: timber floated from Sichuan and Yunnan, bricks fired in Shandong, and grain shipped north along a dredged Grand Canal. Hundreds of thousands of workers built the walled palace now called the Forbidden City, completed in 1420.

On the first day of the new year in 1421 Beijing formally became the principal capital, and Nanjing was demoted to an auxiliary capital with a shadow government. The omens were poor: that May lightning set fire to the three great audience halls, and officials who blamed the move were punished. Yongle's son, the Hongxi Emperor, planned to return south but died in 1425, and in 1441 Beijing's status was confirmed for good.

The move tied the empire's political centre to the northern frontier and to the canal that fed it. Apart from the Nationalist years after 1928, Beijing has been China's capital ever since.
story.zh:
北平是永乐帝为燕王时的根基，又靠近他意欲防范的蒙古边境。自1406年起，他倾力营建：楠木自四川、云南放排而来，城砖在山东烧制，粮食经疏浚后的大运河北运。数十万工匠民夫兴建起今称紫禁城的宫城，于1420年落成。

永乐十九年正月初一（1421年），北京正式成为京师，南京降为留都，保留一套备员的中央机构。兆头却不佳：当年四月雷火焚毁奉天、华盖、谨身三大殿，借此非议迁都的官员遭到惩处。其子洪熙帝曾打算还都南京，但于1425年去世；1441年北京的京师地位最终确定。

迁都使帝国的政治中心与北部边防以及供养京城的运河紧紧相连。除1928年后国民政府定都南京的时期外，北京此后一直是中国的首都。

summary.en: Persuaded by the eunuch Wang Zhen to campaign in person, the Zhengtong Emperor was routed by the Oirat leader Esen at Tumu fortress and taken prisoner. Minister Yu Qian enthroned his brother and defended Beijing.
summary.zh: 明英宗听信宦官王振亲征瓦剌，于土木堡被也先击溃俘虏；兵部尚书于谦拥立景泰帝，固守北京。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
张廷玉等《明史》卷10 英宗前纪 正统十四年
张廷玉等《明史》卷170 于谦传

story.en:
In the summer of 1449 the Oirat leader Esen raided the Ming frontier. The 22-year-old Zhengtong Emperor, urged on by his favourite eunuch Wang Zhen, decided to lead a vast army against him in person, over the objections of his ministers. The campaign was badly supplied and badly led; Wang Zhen reportedly changed the route so the army would pass his home estate and then changed it again.

Retreating towards Beijing, the army camped at the waterless post of Tumu. On 1 September Esen's cavalry surrounded it, and the Ming host disintegrated. Wang Zhen was killed, many senior officials died, and the emperor himself was taken prisoner.

In Beijing the war minister Yu Qian rejected calls to flee south, put the emperor's brother on the throne as the Jingtai Emperor so that Esen's hostage lost his value, and beat off the Oirats outside the city walls. The captive was released in 1450 and regained the throne in a palace coup in 1457, after which Yu Qian was executed. The disaster turned the Ming to a defensive frontier policy that culminated in the great brick walls of the following century.
story.zh:
1449年夏，瓦剌首领也先侵扰明朝边境。二十二岁的明英宗在宠信宦官王振的怂恿下，不顾群臣劝阻，决定御驾亲征。大军粮草不继、调度混乱；据载王振一度改道，想让大军经过他的家乡蔚州，随即又改回原路。

大军撤回北京途中驻扎在缺水的土木堡。9月1日，也先骑兵合围，明军全线溃败。王振被杀，众多重臣阵亡，英宗本人被俘。

在北京，兵部尚书于谦力排南迁之议，拥立英宗之弟为景泰帝，使也先手中的人质失去要挟价值，并在京城外击退瓦剌军。英宗于1450年被放还，1457年通过“夺门之变”复辟，于谦随即被杀。此役之后，明朝转向守势边防，最终在下一个世纪修筑起砖石长城。

summary.en: Nurhaci's Later Jin destroyed three of four converging Ming columns one after another in five days near Sarhu, shifting the balance of power in Liaodong to the Manchus.
summary.zh: 努尔哈赤“凭尔几路来，我只一路去”，五日内于萨尔浒等地各个击破明军四路中的三路，辽东攻守之势自此逆转。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
张廷玉等《明史》卷259 杨镐传
《满洲实录》卷5

story.en:
In 1618 the Jurchen leader Nurhaci, who had proclaimed the Later Jin khanate two years earlier, announced his "Seven Grievances" against the Ming and captured Fushun. Beijing responded with its largest expedition in decades. The commander Yang Hao divided roughly 100,000 men, with Korean auxiliaries, into four columns that were to converge on Nurhaci's capital at Hetu Ala in the spring of 1619.

Nurhaci concentrated his banners instead; his reported maxim was "however many roads you come by, I go by one." The western column under Du Song pushed ahead across the Hun River and was destroyed at Sarhu and Jiefan in mid-April. Within days the northern column of Ma Lin and the eastern column of Liu Ting were crushed in turn, and Liu Ting died fighting. Only the southern column, recalled in time, escaped.

The defeat cost the Ming most of its field army in the northeast and its best officers. Nurhaci took Kaiyuan and Tieling that year and Shenyang and Liaoyang in 1621. Sarhu marked the point at which the Jurchen Later Jin, the future Manchu Qing, moved from defence to conquest.
story.zh:
1618年，两年前建立后金的努尔哈赤以“七大恨”告天，攻陷抚顺。明廷随即发动数十年来规模最大的远征，经略杨镐将约十万明军及朝鲜援军分为四路，约定于1619年春会攻努尔哈赤的都城赫图阿拉。

努尔哈赤则集中八旗兵力，据载其方略是“凭尔几路来，我只一路去”。杜松所率西路军抢先渡过浑河，于4月中旬在萨尔浒、界凡一带全军覆没。数日之内，马林的北路军和刘綎的东路军相继被击溃，刘綎力战而死。只有及时奉命撤回的李如柏南路军得以保全。

此役使明朝在辽东的野战主力和精锐将领损失殆尽。努尔哈赤当年攻取开原、铁岭，1621年又夺取沈阳、辽阳。萨尔浒之战标志着后金由防御转入进攻。

summary.en: Ming commander Yuan Chonghuan, using Portuguese-style cannon on the walls of Ningyuan (Xingcheng), repulsed Nurhaci's assault – his first major defeat; Nurhaci died later that year.
summary.zh: 袁崇焕凭宁远孤城与红夷大炮击退努尔哈赤，后金首遭大败，努尔哈赤同年病逝。
